title: rhododendron tomentosum subsp. decumbens
intro: Rhododendron tomentosum subsp. decumbens, commonly known as alpine rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron tomentosum subsp. decumbens include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
